notablePrerequisites:
Nyx Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to blue is at least three.
description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Bring to Life by paying {2}{U}, causing Nyx Lotus to become a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
